purpose: Implement one host-neutral read-only FocusContext bound to the current DAW-00B workspace observation so exact deictic targeting is allowed only for current OBSERVED_EXACT dimensions and stale, ambiguous, inferred or unknown focus is refused rather than guessed.

lineage.outcome: Artist references such as this track, these notes or this section resolve safely across peer hosts or expose uncertainty instead of targeting the wrong musical object.
lineage.capability: Universal FocusContext with exact-target and stale/ambiguity gate

legacy_rejections: Ableton selection vocabulary as universal API
stale focus reused after workspace change

completion_proof: TRACK, CLIP_REGION, TIME_RANGE, MIDI_NOTES, DEVICE_PLUGIN, AUTOMATION, PLAYHEAD, ACTIVE_EDITOR and SONG_SECTION are canonical focus dimensions
OBSERVED_EXACT focus can be required and returned as exact target refs
missing/UNKNOWN, OBSERVED_AMBIGUOUS and INFERRED dimensions refuse exact targeting
FocusContext is bound to exact workspace ID, Song ID, workspace observation ID and host-runtime fingerprint
workspace move/recovery or runtime-observation change invalidates prior focus as stale
dimension shape and duplicate dimension validation fail visibly
capture, current validation and exact-target reads write zero rows
FocusContextService exposes no host-specific selection or mutation verb
next_selection_rule: After DAW-00C evidence, reconcile and globally compare Host Shadow/reconciliation, host feature/environment evidence, Musical IR/portability and remaining PLATFORM-00/CORE-02 work. Do not select a named DAW adapter by historical maturity.
